description: This file defines the Location class within the OrangeHRM system that extends FilterField and implements ValueXNormalizable. It provides methods to add location-based filtering conditions to a query, convert location IDs to array form, and retrieve entity aliases. It interacts with the LocationService to fetch location details by ID.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: Represents a location filter field used in report queries, enabling filtering by location IDs with support for various selection modes.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds location filtering conditions to the query builder based on the operator and selected location IDs.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns array of entity aliases used in queries, here ['location'].

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Converts the location ID(s) to an array with 'id' and 'label' using LocationService, or returns null if invalid.
